title: IBM Cloud Hardware Firewall
introduction: A hardware firewall is a network device that is connected upstream from a server. The firewall blocks unwanted traffic from a server before the traffic ever reaches the server.

tiles.title: IBM shared hardware firewall is deprecated as on 17 December 2025. It will reach end of support on 31 December 2026.
Account administrators can now assign permissions to allow users to view and manage various parts of a hardware firewall.
